summary: Diagnosed ISS-0714 / GH #809 root cause (WF-03 Step 1, diagnosis only — no fix implemented). Reproduced `zig build migrate` against BPM_DB_URL (5442/bpm_dev): CLI shows only `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed` + ISS-0706 leg-(d) post-condition abort (exit 1). Surfaced the swallowed SQL error from the Postgres server log: 001_event_store.sql line 48 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_event_idempotency ON events(idempotency_key) -> SQLSTATE 42P16 (unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns; DETAIL: lacks column created_at which is part of the partition key). Root cause: STATE MISMATCH — tenant_default already provisioned with modern shape (events PARTITIONED BY RANGE(created_at) from 1147_par01) but public.schema_migrations has 0 rows for schema_name='tenant_default' and tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL, so runForSchema re-applies the whole set from 001 against the partitioned events. NOT a migration-set defect (test DB 5434 passes 147/147 public + 111 tenant_default with same partitioned shape). Fix = repair dev DB only: populate tenant_default ledger + stamp migrations_applied_at. Written to docs/issues/ISS-0714.json (root_cause_analysis) and commented on GH #809 (#issuecomment-5307094779).

tests_run.name: zig build migrate (dev DB 5442/bpm_dev, reproduce)
tests_run.detail: exit 1: default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed; leg-(d) post-condition abort. Expected — confirms the reported failure. Underlying SQL error captured from docker logs r-co-db-1 (42P16, 001 uq_event_idempotency).

tests_run.name: read-only dev DB inspection (psql via docker exec)
tests_run.detail: 58 tenant_default tables; events partitioned RANGE(created_at); 0 tenant_default ledger rows; tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at NULL; public ledger 88 rows.

tests_run.name: test DB comparison (5434/bpm_test)
tests_run.detail: 147 public + 111 tenant_default ledger rows; migrations_applied_at NOT NULL; same partitioned events shape — proves migration set is correct.

issues_found.description: runForSchema() (src/db/migrations.zig) swallows the per-migration SQL error (simpleQuery catch -> ROLLBACK -> return MigrationFailed) with no logging; migrate.zig logs only the error enum name. Root-cause diagnosis required reading the Postgres server log. Consider logging filename+error on migration failure to make future failures self-diagnosing. Tracked as a note; not filed separately.

next_steps: CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2): design dev-DB-only repair — populate public.schema_migrations schema_name='tenant_default' with the 111 non-public-only migrations (canonical ref = test DB tenant_default ledger) + UPDATE tenant_schemas SET migrations_applied_at=NOW() for default tenant; verify 001's partitioned-events unique indexes are not re-attempted.

Do NOT re-run `zig build migrate` as the fix — it will keep failing until the ledger is reconciled.
